issue_body: ### Issue Description On `/settings/profile` page there is an option to save typed signature. Signature font is not always loaded property. When user load `/settings/profile` page as first, font is not loaded property. This problem does not occur when this page is loaded as, for example, second page in session. Signature window probably doesn't wait for UI font and use backup font. ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Save typed signature on your profile 2. Open `/settings/profile` page as first page in session (on new window type manually [https://app.documenso.com/settings/profile](https://app.documenso.com/settings/profile)) 3. Look on typed signature font This problem does not occur when you open other page (ex. [https://app.documenso.com/settings/document](https://app.documenso.com/settings/document) and then go to profile page by UI interface. ### Expected Behavior ### Current Behavior ### Screenshots (optional) _No response_ ### Operating System [e.g., Windows 10] Windows 11 ### Browser [e.g., Chrome, Firefox] Chrome 148 ### Version [e.g., 2.0.1] v2.11.0 ### Please check the boxes that apply to this issue report. - [x] I have searched the existing issues to make sure this is not a duplicate. - [x] I have provided steps to reproduce the issue. - [x] I have included relevant environment information. - [x] I have included any relevant screenshots. - [x] I understand that this is a voluntary contribution and that there is no guarantee of resolution. - [ ] I want to work on creating a PR for this issue if approved
issue_title: Typed signature is not always loaded property
pr_title: fix: load typed signature font on profile page
